End of the War
The war is over. The Free Peoples have persevered, and won the future for their children. Long live freedom!
The realms of Men and Elf alike have been crushed. Long live Sauron!
Chronicle Events
{TARGET} changes hands before the battle can be decided.
The Fellowship Sets Out
Nine walkers leave Rivendell in secret, bearing the One Ring south. The house of Elrond gathers its strength.
The Bridge of Khazad-dûm
In the deeps of Moria the Grey Pilgrim falls with the Balrog. The orcs of the Misty Mountains swarm, and the Free Peoples mourn.
The Breaking of the Fellowship
At Parth Galen the Uruk-hai fall upon the Company. Boromir dies defending the hobbits, and Gondor loses its heir.
Théoden King
Freed from the counsel of Wormtongue, Théoden takes up his sword. The Riddermark musters to its king.
The Battle of the Hornburg
The host of Isengard and the hillmen of Dunland march on {TARGET}. The battle must be decided within {DAYS} days.
No assault comes to {TARGET}. The muster of Isengard turns elsewhere.
The host of Isengard storms {TARGET} through the night, and at dawn the Hornburg still stands.
The Hornburg holds through the night, and the host of Isengard breaks against its walls.
{TARGET} falls, and the White Hand rules the Westfold.
The Last March of the Ents
The Ents of Fangorn come down upon Isengard and drown the pits of Saruman. The forges of the White Hand fall silent.
Lothlórien Assailed
Out of Dol Guldur the Shadow assails the Golden Wood. {TARGET} must stand for {DAYS} days.
The armies of Dol Guldur never reach {TARGET}.
The power of the Lady holds, and the hosts of Dol Guldur fall back from the Golden Wood.
{TARGET} burns, and the light of Lothlórien wanes.
The Fall of Osgiliath
The Morgul host crosses the Anduin toward {TARGET}. Gondor must hold the ruined city for {DAYS} days.
Mordor does not come against {TARGET}, and the river stays quiet.
Faramir holds the crossings of the Anduin, and the Morgul host draws back.
{TARGET} falls, and the road to Minas Tirith lies open.
The Battle of Dale
Easterlings and the servants of Dol Guldur march against the realm of Dale. {TARGET} must hold for {DAYS} days.
The Easterlings turn aside, and {TARGET} is spared.
Men of Dale and Dwarves of Erebor stand together, and the Easterling host is thrown back.
{TARGET} falls to the Easterlings, and the Dwarves of Erebor ride out to aid their friends.
The Corsairs of Umbar
The black sails of Umbar come up the Anduin toward {TARGET}. Gondor must hold the port for {DAYS} days.
The Corsairs linger at sea, and {TARGET} is left in peace.
The fleets of Umbar are driven from {TARGET}, and the southern fiefs of Gondor take heart.
The Corsairs seize {TARGET}, and their ships command the river.
War in the North
Orcs of Gundabad and the hillmen of Dunland come down on the North. {TARGET} must hold for {DAYS} days.
The northern war passes {TARGET} by.
The Rangers and the men of Arthedain hold {TARGET}, and the North stays free.
{TARGET} falls, and the shadow spreads across Eriador.
The Siege of Gondor
The Lord of the Nazgûl leads the hosts of Mordor against {TARGET}. The city must hold for {DAYS} days.
The great host of Mordor holds back, and {TARGET} waits under a darkened sky.
The Rohirrim come at dawn, and the siege of {TARGET} is broken on the Pelennor Fields.
The gates of {TARGET} are broken, and the White City falls to Mordor.
The Black Gate Opens
The Captains of the West march to the Morannon to draw the Eye from the Ring-bearer. The fate of the war now rests with the Ring.
